name: Electrical & Electronic Engineering Materials
summary: How conductors, dielectrics, magnetic materials, semiconductors and superconductors behave, and how to choose them in electrical design.

topics.name: Atomic bonding and crystal structure relevant to electrical properties
Conductors: free-electron model, resistivity and temperature dependence
Matthiessen's rule, alloys, thin films and contact resistance
Dielectrics: polarization, permittivity, loss tangent and breakdown
Magnetic materials: dia-, para- and ferromagnetism, hysteresis
Soft and hard magnetic materials, ferrites and core losses
Insulating materials for cables and high-voltage equipment
Thermal properties: thermal conductivity, expansion and CTE mismatch
Materials in electronic assembly: solders, laminates, encapsulants
